description:
Welcome to Amor de Goa by Mirashya Homes, a one-bedroom serviced apartment in Candolim. The stay is set up for a quiet couple's visit: a private jacuzzi on the balcony, a bright living room, a separate bedroom, and a kitchen you can actually cook in.

The apartment is inside a gated building with a shared swimming pool, free parking, and a caretaker on the property. Candolim Beach, cafés, and the evening stretch toward Calangute are a short ride away. Fort Aguada and Sinquerim are easy to reach, and MOPA airport is typically 35 to 40 minutes by car.

Inside you will find high-speed Wi-Fi, a dedicated workspace, a smart TV, fresh linens, and housekeeping during the stay. Pets are welcome. The building has exterior security cameras in the common areas.

This is a self check-in apartment. The lockbox code is sent before arrival, and the host team is available if the door, the jacuzzi, or the pool hours need a hand.

cancellation.summary: Free cancellation before check-in. Cancel before the day of arrival for a full refund of the stay total shown in this demo.
details: Cancel more than 24 hours before check-in for a full refund of the stay total.
Cancellations within 24 hours of check-in are refunded for unused nights, excluding the first night.
The reservation in this demo does not charge a card. Confirming only records the stay.
Fire extinguisher and first aid kit in the kitchen cupboard
Exterior security cameras cover the entrance and pool deck. They do not look into the apartment.
The balcony jacuzzi and shared pool have no lifeguard
Pool depth varies. Not suitable for unsupervised children

reviews.name: Amit
reviews.text: Very helpful and responsive team. Safe and peaceful stay. loved everything about the property.

reviews.name: Aheesh
reviews.preview: We had a wonderful stay. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as shown in the photos. The host was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We would definitely recommend this place and would love to stay here again.
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as shown in the photos. The host was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We would definitely recommend this place and would love to stay here again. Check-in was simple, and the apartment stayed quiet in the evenings.

reviews.name: Samiksha
reviews.text: the host nitish was really great help

reviews.name: Vedant
reviews.preview: We had an amazing stay at this property in Goa! The entire home was spotless and exceptionally well-maintained, making us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. The cleanliness standards were truly impressive, with every corner of the house looking fresh and pristine....
reviews.text: We had an amazing stay at this property in Goa! The entire home was spotless and exceptionally well-maintained, making us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. The cleanliness standards were truly impressive, with every corner of the house looking fresh and pristine. The host answered every question before we arrived, and check-in with the lockbox was simple.

reviews.name: Maya
reviews.text: We came for a long weekend and used the kitchen every morning. Cookware, coffee, and a proper fridge were all there. The pool is shared but never felt crowded before noon.

reviews.name: Daniel
reviews.text: Accurate listing. The gym in the building is small but enough for a short workout. Location is convenient for north Goa without being in the loudest lane. I took one star off only because the sofa is a little firm.

reviews.name: Aisha
reviews.text: Mirashya Homes was responsive when we asked for a late checkout. The apartment smells clean, linens were fresh, and the bathroom had reliable hot water. Pets are genuinely welcome — our dog had a water bowl waiting.

reviews.name: Leo
reviews.text: A calm base for Candolim. We walked to dinner most nights and used the car for Fort Aguada. Self check-in meant we did not have to wait after a delayed flight.

reviews.name: Priya
reviews.text: The living room gets lovely light in the morning. Photos match the space. I liked that the bedroom has shades that actually darken the room.

reviews.name: Owen
reviews.text: Hot tub on the balcony, pool downstairs, beach nearby. That is the whole review. Also: the smoke alarm and extinguisher were easy to spot, which I always look for.

reviews.name: Ritika
reviews.text: Lovely stay with my sister. The apartment fits two people comfortably and a third on a short visit. Value felt fair for Candolim in season. Communication from the co-host was warm and specific.

reviews.name: Hugo
reviews.text: We cooked two nights and ate out the rest. The kitchen is compact and complete. Candolim is an easy neighborhood if you want the beach without staying on top of a club.

reviews.name: Meera
reviews.text: Everything in the listing was there: workspace, Wi-Fi, parking, pool, jacuzzi. No surprises. The building cameras are outside only, which the host had already explained.

reviews.name: Chris
reviews.text: Arrived after dark and the lockbox was exactly where the photo said. Apartment was cool because the AC had been left on a timer. Thoughtful host team.

reviews.name: Anjali
reviews.text: Romantic without being fussy. The bedroom is the nicest part — crisp linen and a fan if you do not want AC all night. We spent one afternoon just on the balcony.

reviews.name: Noah
reviews.text: Great location for a first Goa trip. Fort, beach, and cafés were all simple from here. The shared gym was a bonus I did not expect to use, and I did.

reviews.name: Tara
reviews.text: Clean, accurate, and easy. Housekeeping mid-stay was discreet. I messaged about extra towels and they were at the door the same hour.

reviews.name: Vikram
reviews.text: The 1BHK layout works well. Living room for the day, bedroom for sleep, balcony for the evening. Candolim traffic exists, but the building itself is calm.

reviews.name: Elena
reviews.text: We stayed five nights and never felt like we were missing a hotel. The apartment has the practical things — iron, hair dryer, blackout shades — and the not-so-practical thing we actually came for, which is the jacuzzi. Mirashya Homes knows how to look after a small place.
